Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
	
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.	
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.	
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.	
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.	
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.	
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

	
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.	
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.	
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.	
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.	
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.	
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. 
Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Turkish is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

the client is a leading international professional services and consulting firm that supports organisations in their digital transformation journey. Working with both local and multinational clients, you will help businesses optimise their commercial, marketing and customer service processes through innovative CRM solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale transformation programmes, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and contribute to projects that have a tangible impact on clients' business performance.

Jobomschrijving

As Salesforce Consultant, you will have the fllowing responsibilities:

• Partner with Belgian and international organisations to analyse business challenges across Sales, Marketing and Customer Service.

• Lead or own specific workstreams while collaborating closely with functional and technical consultants to ensure successful project delivery.
• Participate in all phases of CRM implementation projects, including business analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post go-live support.
• Contribute to business development initiatives by supporting client proposals, presentations and commercial opportunities.
• Work within cross-functional teams in an agile project environment to deliver high-quality solutions.

• At least 3 years of experience working with Salesforce in either a functional or technical consulting role.
• Proven involvement in several CRM implementation projects from analysis through delivery.
• Good understanding of customer relationship management processes and commercial business operations.
• Ability to translate commercial objectives and business requirements into practical technical solutions.
• Familiarity with Sales, Marketing and/or Customer Service functions.
• Experience working in Agile environments is considered an advantage.
• Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
• Comfortable working in multidisciplinary and international environments.
• Fluent in English together with either Dutch or French.
• Experience with Salesforce is essential; exposure to other enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP or Oracle is considered a plus.

Backed by a strong culture of innovation and continuous improvement, the company is recognized for its commitment to customer excellence, people development and sustainable growth.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.	
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.	
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.	
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.	
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

 

The cream recipe:

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects 

Like Teddy, Business Analyst Business Intelligence at Cream, translate the BI needs of the business teams in specifications for the IT department, for both small demands or as part of larger projects (contributions or BI project). Your tasks will be

• Act as person of contact between Business Engineering Teams and the Development Team

• Define the business specifications for BI needs

• Participation in (or management of) BI projects, or on the BI tracks of other projects for the engineering activities (requirement definition, impact analysis, process definition), while representing the BI vision (and BI target architecture) that has been defined

• Collaboration with data delivery experts to deliver on projects

• Understand business requirements and build a functional analysis which covers needs of the business according to our BI reference architecture

• Collaborate with the development team

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master degree in Computer Sciences or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 2 years of experience in data and business analysis

• You have good knowledge in BI techniques and tools (BO, SAS, Cognos...)

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer oriented, and you have high communication skills and analytical skills

• You are polyvalent and can adapt easily to quickly changing environment

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English; a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request
